description: List the GripForge Library locker (characters, enemies, weapons, props, textures, HUD, buttons, binds). Filter by kind and/or game style. Every item carries `rank` {score/100, grade A–D, reasons}: fitness for a GripForge game; sort=rank lists the best fit first. engine filters on the generator: engine=compute lists GripForge Compute assets (manufactures and variants), each with a `compute` block {level scene/detail, family, triangles, edit_url, file_url}.

engine.description: Generator that made the item: compute (GripForge Compute), meshy, tripo, gpu…

sort.description: newest (default) or rank: best fit first

style.description: Game look id or alias (e.g. souls-like, open-world-adventure)

subtype.description: Subtype within the selected kind, e.g. quadruped under creatures.

target.description: Platform for the rank budgets. Defaults to mobile.

workspace_id.description: Explicit workspace id. The key must have access to it.

name: gripforge_library_list
